name: ReturnsOS – Returns & Exchanges with AI Photo Verification, Exchange-First Offers, Reverse Pickup & Store Credit

parameters.content:
## 📦 ReturnsOS – Returns & Exchanges with AI Photo Check

For Shopify D2C brands in India whose support team handles every return over email and WhatsApp. They eyeball photos, argue about windows, issue refunds that could have been exchanges, and book reverse pickups by hand.

### How it works
A customer fills in a return form with photos. The order is verified in Shopify and checked against your policy: return window, damage window, non-returnable items and repeat-return abuse. GPT-4o inspects the photos against the claimed reason. The workflow then offers exchange first, store credit with a bonus next, and refund (with a fee) last, so you keep more revenue. High-value or unclear cases go to an agent in Slack with Approve and Reject links.

When the customer taps their choice, a Shiprocket reverse pickup is booked, store credit is issued as a Shopify gift card, and everyone is told what happens next.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Shopify custom app with `read_orders` and `write_gift_cards`, and add its token as Header Auth (`X-Shopify-Access-Token`).
2. Add Shiprocket as a Custom Auth credential with `{"body":{"email":"…","password":"…"}}`.
3. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets (a **Returns Log** tab), Gmail, Slack and WhatsApp Business Cloud.
4. Edit **Set Return Policy & Config** and the warehouse in **Build Reverse Pickup**, and set your store domain in **Issue Store Credit Gift Card**.
5. Submit a test return with photos.

## 📝 Request & Eligibility
The customer submits order number, contact, reason and photos. The order is looked up in Shopify to confirm it's theirs and delivered. The return window, damage window, non-returnable tags and repeat-return abuse are checked against your policy.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – AI Photo Check & Decision

parameters.content:
## 🔍 AI Photo Check & Decision
GPT-4o compares the photos with the claimed reason: is it really damaged, the wrong item, or unused with tags? The decision engine then leans to exchange first, offers bonus store credit, and sends high-value or low-confidence cases to a human.

## 🔗 Link Check
Customer choices and agent decisions arrive on one webhook. Each link carries a one-time token and is checked against the return's status before anything happens.

## 👤 Agent Review
An approval sends the customer their options. A rejection emails the reason. Either way, the agent sees a confirmation page.

## 🚚 Pickup & Store Credit
Once the customer chooses, a Shiprocket reverse pickup is booked to your warehouse. Store-credit choices also get a Shopify gift card with the bonus added.

## ✅ Confirm Resolution
The return is updated with pickup and credit details, the customer gets a WhatsApp and a confirmation page, and ops sees what to do next (ship the exchange or process the refund).

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Shiprocket login and the Shopify token live in n8n credentials, never in code. Choice links are one-time and status-checked. Return photos and addresses are customer data, so keep the Returns Log private and limit the Slack channel to support.

parameters.content:
## 📨 Offer, Review or Decline
Approved returns get one-tap options on WhatsApp and email. Cases needing a human go to Slack with Approve and Reject links, and the customer is told it's under review. Ineligible requests get a clear, polite reason.
